import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.feature_extraction.text import TfidfVectorizer
from sklearn.svm import LinearSVC
from sklearn.calibration import CalibratedClassifierCV
from sklearn.metrics import log_loss
from sklearn.preprocessing import LabelEncoder
import os

# Create submission directory if it doesn't exist
os.makedirs("./submission", exist_ok=True)

# Load data
train_df = pd.read_csv("./input/train.csv")
test_df = pd.read_csv("./input/test.csv")
sample_submission = pd.read_csv("./input/sample_submission.csv")

# Encode labels
label_encoder = LabelEncoder()
label_encoder.fit(["EAP", "HPL", "MWS"])
y = label_encoder.transform(train_df["author"])

# Split training data for validation (80/20)
X_train, X_val, y_train, y_val = train_test_split(
    train_df["text"], y, test_size=0.2, random_state=42, stratify=y
)

# Create TF-IDF vectorizers for word and character n-grams
word_vectorizer = TfidfVectorizer(
    analyzer="word",
    ngram_range=(1, 3),
    max_features=10000,
    sublinear_tf=True,
    strip_accents="unicode",
    lowercase=True,
)

char_vectorizer = TfidfVectorizer(
    analyzer="char",
    ngram_range=(3, 5),
    max_features=10000,
    sublinear_tf=True,
    strip_accents="unicode",
    lowercase=True,
)

# Fit and transform training data
X_train_word = word_vectorizer.fit_transform(X_train)
X_train_char = char_vectorizer.fit_transform(X_train)

X_val_word = word_vectorizer.transform(X_val)
X_val_char = char_vectorizer.transform(X_val)

# Combine features
from scipy.sparse import hstack

X_train_combined = hstack([X_train_word, X_train_char])
X_val_combined = hstack([X_val_word, X_val_char])

# Train LinearSVC with calibration
base_clf = LinearSVC(C=1.0, max_iter=5000, random_state=42, class_weight="balanced")

clf = CalibratedClassifierCV(base_clf, cv=5, method="sigmoid")
clf.fit(X_train_combined, y_train)

# Predict on validation set
val_proba = clf.predict_proba(X_val_combined)
val_proba = np.clip(val_proba, 1e-15, 1 - 1e-15)

# Calculate multi-class log loss
val_log_loss = log_loss(y_val, val_proba)
print(f"Validation Multi-class Log Loss: {val_log_loss}")

# Transform test data
X_test_word = word_vectorizer.transform(test_df["text"])
X_test_char = char_vectorizer.transform(test_df["text"])
X_test_combined = hstack([X_test_word, X_test_char])

# Predict on test set
test_proba = clf.predict_proba(X_test_combined)
test_proba = np.clip(test_proba, 1e-15, 1 - 1e-15)

# Create submission file
submission = pd.DataFrame(
    {
        "id": test_df["id"],
        "EAP": test_proba[:, 0],
        "HPL": test_proba[:, 1],
        "MWS": test_proba[:, 2],
    }
)

# Save submission
submission.to_csv("./submission/submission.csv", index=False)
print("Submission saved to ./submission/submission.csv")
